layman_headline: All three positions are green — let the winners ride toward their targets.
layman_explanation: The entire crypto market just had a massive week, with Bitcoin up over 22% and most altcoins following. Our three open positions — Ethereum, Hyperliquid, and Solana — are all profitable, up 4-7% each. The market sentiment has flipped from neutral to greedy very quickly, which means now is the time to be disciplined rather than chase new entries. The swing candidates available either already ran hard or are stablecoins with no upside.
layman_action: Hold your current positions and let them work toward their profit targets. ETH is closest to its exit target at $2,520 — consider taking profits there. Don't add new positions into this euphoria.
expert_reasoning: The market has moved aggressively — BTC +22.6% in 7 days, ETH +28.8%, HYPE +34.7%, SOL +21.5%. Fear & Greed jumped from a weekly average of 45.7 to 72 in one session, signaling rapid sentiment shift into greed territory. All swing candidates are either overbought (PUMP RSI 75), already extended (MON +36% despite RSI 41 which is contradictory — likely a recent listing with limited history), or are stablecoins/gold tokens with no swing potential. BTC dominance at 59.2% remains unfavorable for new alt entries. The prudent move is to hold existing winners and tighten mental stops. ETH is within 4% of its $2,520 exit target and should be monitored for profit-taking. CryptoSlate's warning about Treasury yield spikes potentially stalling the ETF-driven rally adds a cautionary note — and CryptoSlate has been our most reliable news signal at 67% win rate.
